node.statement: The theta correction in def-compressed-corner is natural for entrywise amplification: whenever theta(T) is defined by that fixed functional calculus, theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). Indeed iota_n is a unital algebra homomorphism for composition. For every lambda on a functional-calculus contour, the inverse identity (lambda 1-iota_n(T))^{-1}=iota_n((lambda 1-T)^{-1}) is checked entry by entry; substituting it into the contour formula for theta and using linearity of iota_n proves the claimed equality. The same inverse identity also shows that T and iota_n(T) have the same relevant spectral separation, so the uniform smallness choice from the first step suffices.
